_readme: The LIVE events calendar. Edit this file, push to main, and GitHub Pages redeploys it in about a minute - players pick the changes up on their next app launch, with no app update and no review. Served at https://wrexist.github.io/DeepLifeSimulator/liveops.json and read by lib/liveops/remote.ts. Events here are ADDED to the ones compiled into the app (lib/liveops/catalogue.ts); publishing an id that already exists there REPLACES it, which is how a shipped event gets corrected without a build. Anything malformed is dropped on its own rather than taking the calendar down, and every reward is capped on the device - see docs/LIVEOPS.md. __tests__/liveops/publishedCalendar.test.ts validates this file in CI, so a typo fails the build rather than reaching players.
_kill_switches: disabledEventIds removes specific events by id, local or remote. paused: true takes the whole system off the air. Both are honoured from the cached copy, so an event killed while a player is online stays killed on their next offline launch.

events.title: First Steps
events.summary: Somewhere to start: a little put by, and a little standing.
events.brief: Nothing here is difficult. It is the sort of week you were probably going to have anyway - this just pays you for it.

events.title: Keep the Wheel Turning
events.summary: Two properties and the income to justify them.
events.brief: The middle of a life is where things either compound or stall. Put a second property under your name and keep earning while you do it.

events.title: New Year, Same Ledger
events.summary: Start the year in better shape than you ended it.
events.brief: Resolutions are cheap. Show three of them holding at once - money set aside, health kept up, and a reputation worth the name.

events.title: The Climb
events.summary: A salary worth having, and the years of work behind it.
events.brief: Careers pay for patience more than for talent. This one asks for both: a salary you had to climb to, and the weeks on the job that got you there.
